acip: MA GRUB NA, DE CHOS CAN, DER THAL, MI RTAG PA DANG 'GAL BA DANG THA DAD GANG ZHIGKHYOD KYANG YIN, MI RTAG PA DANG 'GAL BA YANG YIN PA'I GZHI MTHUN MED PA'I PHYIR,
wylie: ma grub na, de chos can, der thal, mi rtag pa dang 'gal ba dang tha dad gang zhigkhyod kyang yin, mi rtag pa dang 'gal ba yang yin pa'i gzhi mthun med pa'i phyir
english: [It's not correct to say that the exclusion of all that is not a pillar is something such that being it is contradictory to being something which is such that being it is contradictory to being something which is unchanging.] Suppose you say it's not correct. Consider this same thing. It is so, Because it is (1) distinct from that which is such that being it is contradictory to being a changing thing, and (2) such that there does not exist a single thing which is both it [the exclusion of all that is not a pillar] and also something which is such that being it is contradictory to being a changing thing.
